ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ( ISPICKVAL(Fare_Basis__c ,'ID') || ISPICKVAL(Fare_Basis__c ,'DG') || ISPICKVAL(Fare_Basis__c ,'RG') || ISPICKVAL(Fare_Basis__c ,'AD') || ISPICKVAL(Fare_Basis__c ,'GE') ) || ( ISPICKVAL(Fare_Basis__c ,'DM') && Paper_Certificated__c=FALSE ) ) && ( ISPICKVAL(Booking_Class_Departure_External__c,'') || ISPICKVAL(Booking_Class_Returning_External__c,'') || ISPICKVAL(RBD_Departure__c,'') || ISPICKVAL(RBD_Returning__c,'') || ( IF( ISPICKVAL(Certificate_Version__c, 'Chinese'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Itinerary_Departure_CH__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Itinerary_Return_CH__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Itinerary_Departure__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Itinerary_Return__c)) ) ) || ISPICKVAL(Itinerary_Departure__c,'' ) || ISPICKVAL(Itinerary_Return__c,'' ) || ISBLANK(Flight_Date_Departure_External__c) || ISBLANK(Flight_Date_Returning_External__c) || ISBLANK(Flight_Number_Departure_External__c) || ISBLANK(Flight_Number_Returning_External__c) || ISBLANK(First_Name_EN__c) || ISBLANK(Last_Name_EN__c) || ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c) || ISBLANK(Email__c) || ISBLANK(Phone__c) ) && ( RecordType.Name='Free & Reduced Fare Tickets' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pls Fill in Travel & Passenger Info when Discount code = ID,DG,RG,AD,GE or Discount = DM but no need issue paper certificate
